correctness.rationale: The nonlinear p_j generator is minus a convex energy gradient and is well-posed for p_j>1. Monotonicity of phi_p yields two-input vertex l1 dissipativity, hence cross-fiber edge-variation derivatives nonpositive; each factor contracting supplies own-fiber signs. Subadditivity of convex one-sided directional derivatives proves the sum-field inequality without requiring commuting nonlinear flows. Lifted one-coordinate data prove necessity. On stars a leaf impulse gives Jdot=(m-3)c, with m<=3 ensured by the subgradient coefficient 3-m; independent exact p=2 ternary-signal checks and m=4,5 impulses corroborate. The strict assumption of fiber-repeated conductance matters.

final_claim: For finite p_j-heat Cartesian products with repeated factor conductances and unit vertex masses, unweighted coordinate edge variation decays iff it decays in each factor. Paths, cycles and equally weighted complete graphs and stars of at most three leaves are factors; for star-only products a factor with at least four leaves has explicit positive derivative witness.
